verdict.rationale: v0 documents connecting a project to GitHub so its code lives in your own repository, plus direct pushes and API export capabilities for backup and migration. That covers taking the source code out of the platform. However, every documented hosting and deployment path runs through Vercel, and nothing shows the exported app running or hosted elsewhere. Missing for 10: documentation of running or self-hosting the exported app outside Vercel/v0, explicit confirmation that the full project source is included, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating off the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform

citations.quote: Connect a v0 project to GitHub to keep its code in a repository
Connect to GitHub and push code directly to your repository.
Export capabilities for backup and migration
